About Me

Hello! My name is Tanish and I love building things — from LLM-powered data pipelines to full-stack apps and competitive programming solutions. My journey into software started with a fascination for algorithms, and it quickly evolved into a passion for AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems.

I hold a B.Tech in Mathematics & Computing from DTU (2026, 8.64 CGPA), and I'm currently Product Engineering Lead at Sodhani Capital , leading a team of 5 to build a cross-platform stock market analytics platform. Before that, I interned as an AI Engineer at NTT DATA Business Solutions and as an ML Engineer at BiUP.ai , building production systems used by 25,000+ users monthly.

I was also a Core Member at Geek Room , where I organised 10+ hackathons, hireathons, and workshops, helping grow the community to 100,000+ active coders nationwide. Outside of work, I'm a competitive programmer with 1600+ rating and 400+ problems solved across LeetCode, CSES, and Codeforces.

Some Things I've Built

  • Featured Project

    CodeTracer

    Agent-driven DSA visualizations with a fullstack coding platform. Features a real-time contest system with live leaderboards, a full social layer (friend requests, presence, direct messaging), and secure C++ code execution via Judge0 in sandboxed environments. An in-built AI coaching agent dynamically renders algorithm visualizations (arrays, graphs, trees) through agent-controllable React components, powered by a Web Worker-based execution engine with a custom Tracer class API connecting agent-generated code to animated playback.

    • React
    • Socket.IO
    • LangChain
    • Judge0
    • Node.js
    • Web Workers

  • Featured Project

    YTFeed

    A Chrome extension that enhances YouTube recommendations by integrating community-contributed video links. Injects category-based recommended links into users’ YouTube feed using the Chrome API, simulating natural recommendations to enhance the user experience.

    • Chrome Extension
    • Flask
    • PostgreSQL

  • Featured Project

    Zomato Restaurant Recommendation

    A smart recommendation app that generates restaurant embeddings using Qdrant vector database and adapts recommendations based on user feedback. Integrates HNSW indexing and SQLite for persistence, and incorporates Bayesian ratings and budget preferences for personalized results.

    • Qdrant
    • SQLite
    • Python
    • Flask
    • React
